cards.card_text: At that time, the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn.
cards.verse_text: At that time the sign of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn.
cards.snippet: …of the Son of Man will appear in heaven, and all the tribes of the earth will mourn.

cards.card_text: All the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him, and John says so shall it be.
cards.verse_text: And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him.
cards.snippet: And all the tribes of the earth will mourn because of Him.

cards.card_text: Every tribe and tongue and nation The tribe of Judah alone The city of Jerusalem alone
cards.verse_text: And they sang a new song: “Worthy are You to take the scroll and open its seals, because You were slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.
cards.snippet: …slain, and by Your blood You purchased for God those from every tribe and tongue and people and nation.

cards.card_text: Every nation and tribe and tongue The seven churches in Asia The towns around Jerusalem
cards.verse_text: After this I looked and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb.
cards.snippet: …and saw a multitude too large to count, from every nation and tribe and people and tongue, standing before the throne and before the Lamb.

cards.card_text: For three and a half days, all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies.
cards.verse_text: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit them to be laid in a tomb.
cards.snippet: For three and a half days all peoples and tribes and tongues and nations will view their bodies and will not permit…

cards.card_text: Every tribe and nation on earth The kings along the shore of the sea The rulers of one great nation
cards.verse_text: Then the beast was permitted to wage war against the saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.
cards.snippet: …saints and to conquer them, and it was given authority over every tribe and people and tongue and nation.

cards.card_text: Then John sees another angel flying overhead with the eternal gospel to proclaim to every nation and tribe and tongue and people on the earth.
cards.verse_text: Then I saw another angel flying overhead, with the eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
cards.snippet: …to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth—to every nation and tribe and tongue and people.
